tagline: Your comics, DVD and Blu-ray collection: loans, sales, condition.

titleSearch.label: Title, series or author
titleSearch.none: No results: enter the details manually.
titleSearch.applied: Details taken from {{source}}: check them before saving.

lookup.found: Details found via {{source}}: check them before saving.
lookup.known: This edition is already in your collection: the fields have been filled in.
lookup.notFound: Nothing found for this code: enter the details manually.
lookup.invalid: Invalid barcode: check what you entered.

scan.title: Scan a barcode
scan.hint: Place the barcode inside the frame, flat and well lit.
scan.unsupported: Scanning is not available here: it requires Chrome (on Android), an HTTPS connection and camera access. You can enter the code manually.
scan.denied: Camera access denied: allow it for this site in your browser settings.
scan.noCamera: No camera available on this device.

detail.deleteWarning: Its loan and sale history will be deleted too. This cannot be undone.

images.coverHint: Shared by all copies of this edition.
images.photoHint: Shows the actual condition of your copy, useful for a listing.
images.notFoundOnline: No cover found online: upload your own image.

loan.soldNote: A sold copy can no longer be lent.

sale.loanedNote: Get the lent copy back before selling it.
sale.platformHint: The listing below adapts to the platform (title length).
sale.platformUnconfigured: No platforms set up: all known platforms are offered.
sale.cancelSaleText: The copy will be back “on the shelf”.

listingDraft.title: Title
listingDraft.hint: Text generated from the details: read it over and add what is missing (defects, shipping, price) before publishing.

import.title: Import copies
import.intro: Import your collection from a CSV file: one row per copy. Columns are recognized by their name (title, series, volume, authors, format, barcode, publisher, year, language, condition, note, location), in any order.
import.summary: {{total}} rows read: {{valid}} can be imported, {{invalid}} need fixing.
import.toComplete: {{count}} rows will be completed online from the barcode (title, authors, publisher…): values from the file take precedence, and the import may take a few minutes.
import.duplicates: {{count}} rows match an edition already present (or repeated in the file): each will add one more copy.
import.problemsHint: These rows will not be imported. Fix the file and load it again, or import the rest.
import.nothingToImport: No importable rows in this file.
import.failed: The import stopped on an error: copies already created stay in the collection.
import.notFound: This import can no longer be found (the server may have restarted). Check the collection before starting again.

errors.too_large: The file is too large (2 MB maximum).
errors.unreadable: Unable to read this file: check that it still exists and try again.

issues.missing_format: Unknown format: specify book, DVD, Blu-ray or 4K
issues.not_found_online: Barcode unknown online and no title in the file

settings.title: Settings
settings.platformsIntro: Tick the platforms where you have an account: only those are offered when you list a copy for sale. As long as none is ticked, all known platforms are offered.
settings.name: Name
settings.publishUrl: Address of the page for posting a listing (optional)
settings.publishUrlHint: Used for the “Open … to publish the listing” link. Full address, starting with http or https.
settings.defaultHint: Preselected when you list a copy for sale.

errors.invalid: Invalid name or address: the address must start with http:// or https://.

login.title: Log in
login.totpIntro: Enter the 6-digit code shown by your authenticator app.

setup.subtitle: Welcome! Create the first (administrator) account to get started.
setup.tokenHelp: The token is written to the server logs at startup (docker logs shelf-ctrl).

forgot.subtitle: Enter your username or email to receive a reset link.
forgot.sent: If an account matches, a reset link has just been sent by email. Without email set up, ask the administrator: the link is written to the server logs.

reset.subtitle: Choose a new password.
reset.success: Password reset: you can now log in.
reset.invalidToken: This link is invalid or has expired.

profile.title: My account
profile.emailHint: Used to receive a link if you forget your password.
profile.passwordChanged: Password changed. Your other sessions have been closed.

users.title: Users
users.newPassword: New password (leave empty to keep it)
users.confirmRemove: Delete the account “{{name}}” and its whole collection (copies, loans, sales, images)? This cannot be undone.
users.mailIntro: Check that emails (forgotten password) are sent: a test message goes to your address.
users.testEmailSent: Test email sent: check your inbox.
users.confirmDisableTotp: Disable two-factor authentication for “{{name}}” (lost phone, for example)? Their remembered devices will be forgotten.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication (2FA)
twoFactor.enabledIntro: A code from your authenticator app is required at each login, except on remembered devices.
twoFactor.disabledIntro: Protect your account with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Aegis, Authy…).
twoFactor.setupScan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
twoFactor.setupConfirm: Then enter the 6-digit code shown to confirm.
twoFactor.forgetAllConfirm: The code will be asked again at the next login on each device. Forget all devices?
